title: Power Automate: view property values inline on cards in the new cloud flow designer
summary: The roadmap facts, maker navigation path and product-level licensing are supported. The claimed archived inline default and February 2026 target could not be verified: the cited feature link now redirects to a release-plan summary that does not include this feature, and fresh searches found no supporting excerpt.

claims.claim: The feature is an inline property-value view in Power Automate's new cloud flow designer.
claims.quote: Power Automate: Cloud flows - View property value expanded inline in new cloud flow designer

claims.claim: Makers can view property values for multiple steps at design time.
claims.quote: When you add an action, you can view property values for multiple steps at design time, or output values for multiple steps at runtime.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Makers can view output values for multiple steps at runtime.
claims.quote: When you add an action, you can view property values for multiple steps at design time, or output values for multiple steps at runtime.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment
claims.claim: The inline view displays these values directly on the action cards.
claims.quote: The inline view shows this information directly on the cards, so you can review and compare values across several steps at once.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The inline view allows reviewing and comparing several steps' values at once.
claims.quote: The inline view shows this information directly on the cards, so you can review and compare values across several steps at once.

claims.claim: Without the inline view, makers select each card individually to read its value in the side pane.
claims.quote: Without the inline view, you select each card individually to see its value in the side pane, and you can view only one step's value at a time.

claims.claim: The side pane shows only one step's value at a time.
claims.quote: Without the inline view, you select each card individually to see its value in the side pane, and you can view only one step's value at a time.

claims.claim: The maker Layout control is reached through My flows > Cloud flows > flow > Edit > New designer (on) > Collapse (configuration pane) > Layout.
claims.quote: New designer toggle: Switch between the new designer and the classic designer. ... Collapse button: (New designer only) Hide the pane. ... Layout: Switch between inline and panel layouts.

claims.claim: No API or automation operation is documented for a maker's designer layout choice.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Power Automate designer layout inline Power Platform API PowerShell pac admin' and 'cloud flow designer inline layout preference Dataverse table'; read flows-designer, powerapps-powershell, pac admin and manage-flows-with-code excerpts. No layout-setting operation found.

claims.claim: No tenant or environment administrator UI setting or API for the inline property-value view is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Power Automate inline designer administrator setting' and 'Power Platform API tenant settings cloud flow designer inline layout'; read flows-designer, tenant-settings, list-tenantsettings, powerapps-powershell and pac admin. No inline-view administrator control found.

claims.quote: Layout: Switch between inline and panel layouts.

claims.claim: The documented inline layout displays an action's properties in an expanded card.
claims.quote: The inline layout displays an action's properties in an expanded card on the canvas.

claims.claim: The panel layout displays properties in the configuration pane and keeps action cards compact.
claims.quote: The panel layout displays the properties in the configuration pane on the left and keeps the action cards compact.

claims.claim: The designer article does not describe inline property or runtime output values on cards or identify Layout as this roadmap feature's switch.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Power Automate flows-designer Layout inline property output values'; read the entire flows-designer article. It describes configuring action properties with Layout, but does not describe runtime output values on cards or identify the roadmap property's value-view switch.

claims.claim: The reviewed documentation states no separate licence for this inline view.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Power Automate inline designer license meter price'; read types of Power Automate licenses, flows-designer, data-operations, archived planned-features and licensing FAQ excerpts. No separate inline-view licence stated; the roadmap also names none.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The reviewed documentation states no meter specific to the inline view.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Power Automate inline designer license meter price'; read licensing/types, flows-designer, data-operations and pay-as-you-go-meters search excerpts. Published flow-run meters do not meter this display choice; no inline-view meter is stated in these texts or the roadmap.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The sources do not state how this inline view handles actions with Secure outputs enabled.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Power Automate inline Secure outputs'; read flows-designer and excerpts from use-secure-inputs-outputs-triggers and how-tos-use-sensitive-input. General documentation hides secured values in logs/run history, but does not explain this inline card view.

claims.claim: The roadmap description gives no new permission, connection or identity mechanism.
claims.quote: Searched: permission, connection and identity in the full roadmap description. It describes displaying property/runtime output values and selecting a view, with no new permission, connection or identity mechanism stated.

claims.claim: The roadmap refers to the new cloud flow designer and states no additional prerequisite.
claims.quote: Searched: prerequisite and requirement statements in the full roadmap record. The title names the new cloud flow designer; the description describes views and automatic availability, with no further prerequisite stated.

claims.claim: Whether the classic designer offers this specific inline property and runtime output-value view is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Power Automate classic designer property values inline'; read flows-designer and classic-vs-modern-designer excerpts. They compare configuration layouts and new-only investment, but do not state classic support for this particular property/runtime output-value view.
